transcript.text: From what you have described, the most likely cause is cavity lamp / bulb. Does the microwave otherwise work normally (heats, turns, display) and only the inside light has failed?
No the light's fine, it comes on when I open the door. Display is on and it beeps but it won't start.
From what you have described, the most likely cause is control lock / demo mode. Next: Check for a control/child lock and try a power-cycle reset. Let me know what you find.
There's a little L / padlock-looking symbol on the display. I unplugged it for a minute and plugged it back in, but the symbol came back and it still won't start. How do I get rid of it?

The padlock is almost always the child lock, which survives unplugging. On most microwaves you clear it by pressing and holding Stop/Cancel for about 3 seconds until it disappears, but some makes use a dedicated lock or key button or a different combination, so if that doesn't work the exact method will be in the manual for your model. Put a cup of water in and try a minute on full power. Does it start now, or still not?
ok I held the Stop button for 3 secs and the L went away. It works now, thanks.
Good news, that has sorted it. If it happens again, start with the same check. Is there anything else I can help with?
